color-system.twistDescription: No twist — verbatim copy. Filtered for light color_register (pageBackground #f2efe9, luminance 239.2). Warm cream-neutral palette with single saturated orange accent (#fb7339).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Letter spacing injection at 0.06em applied to all heading levels via --font-letter-spacing-heading CSS var. ETmodules proprietary icon font replaced with Space Mono (Google Fonts CDN). Nunito and Nunito Sans served via Google Fonts CDN imports.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Duration scaling slower ×1.3. Primary duration 0.2s → 0.26s. Creates a slightly more deliberate, unhurried pacing consistent with the warm material character of the color system.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Gap value scaling ×1.375 (≈1.4 at intensity 3). Base grid gap 16px → 22px. Responsive column gap 56px → 78px. Creates more generous whitespace between columns for a spacious editorial feel.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Hero padding emphasis ×1.5. hero.paddingBottom 64px → 96px. Added hero.paddingTop at 96px for vertical symmetry. All other spacing values unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist E: Focus state enhancement. Added focus states with outlineWidth: 2px, outlineStyle: solid, outlineOffset: 2px across all interactive components. Transition durations updated to 0.26s to match assembled motion system. No color values changed — outline uses currentColor.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Letter spacing on nav links. Nav letterSpacing set to 0.08em (from 'normal'). Hover underline animation and scroll transition durations updated to 0.26s to align with assembled motion system.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift. Section 5 (Background and Section Design Behavior) rewritten to foreground physical materiality — the tactile quality of the warm cream ground as beeswax, linen, letterpress ink. concept_by_video.md generated fresh with three video placements: hero-bg.mp4 (macro warm fiber surface, 10s), feature-product.mp4 (product UI loop, 8s), material-detail.mp4 (woven fiber ambient, 5s).

consistencyChecks.checkA_colorContrast: PASS — navText black vs transparent (maps to #f2efe9 cream, lum 239): OK; bodyText black vs pageBackground cream: OK
consistencyChecks.checkB_motionCoherence: PASS — motion base 0.26s, interaction hover 0.26s, ratio 1.0
consistencyChecks.checkC_navFont: PASS — nav.typography.fontFamily is 'inherit', inherits from assembled type system

productConcept.name: Pellum
productConcept.description: Small-batch natural ink studio producing pigments milled from foraged minerals and plants. Made for calligraphers, printmakers, and studio artists who demand material integrity. Tagline: Colour drawn from the ground.
